crossRefs.note: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,
Now Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there. Behold, the near kinsman of whom Boaz spoke came by. Boaz said to him…
and I delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of Hanamel…

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Heth
people.line: Son of Canaan and ancestor of the Hittites.

translations.web: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.
translations.bsb: to Abraham’s possession in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city.
translations.kjv: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
translations.asv: unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
